sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 固定 2026-09-01 PvPoke 快照用於 #614～#643 的 exact speciesId 與 Open GL／UL／ML 物種排名。普通／伽勒爾泥巴魚、普通／洗翠勇士雄鷹、龍捲雲與雷電雲的化身／靈獸形態都有獨立 battle identity，不需要共享 generic mapping。

boundary: All 34 candidate forms have independent pinned PvPoke battle identities. Form-specific ranks must remain isolated: ordinary/Galarian Stunfisk, ordinary/Hisuian Braviary, and Incarnate/Therian Tornadus/Thundurus never borrow one another's ranks. Shadow IDs are recorded only when the pinned gamemaster contains the concrete speciesId; no `_shadow` ID is synthesized. PvPoke battle presence, including Tornadus/Thundurus Incarnate Shadow and Shadow Reshiram identities, is never Pokémon GO release evidence.
